lines.zh: 我的头是个气球，晃来晃去。
lines.en: My head is a balloon, bobbing about.

lines.zh: 我从展示位挪到另一处。
lines.en: I shift from one display spot to another.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上滑，不抬起来。
lines.en: My feet slide rather than lift.
I make one circuit of the cabinets.
I carry a sign in my hand.

lines.zh: 我走两步就停，摆个姿势。
lines.en: Two steps, then a pose.
My streamers drag behind me.
I move to where the light is brightest.
My joints make no sound. Very quiet.
I stop in front of the arcade cabinet.
I raise the sign a little.
I angle aside to clear the aisle.
I move around to the far side of the counter.
I smooth my streamers straight.
I walk to the door and back.
I switch the sign to my other hand.

lines.zh: 我站在展示位上，举着牌子。
lines.en: I stand on the display spot holding my sign.
By day I am only for show.
My balloon head turns slowly.
I face the door and smile.
My hand stays raised; it never tires.

lines.zh: 我照着一面玻璃整理彩带。
lines.en: I tidy my streamers in the glass.
The cabinet lights blink.
I wait for night.
My feet have not moved.

lines.zh: 有人从我面前走过，我挥手。
lines.en: Someone passes; I wave.

lines.zh: 我不需要人陪着，也不拒绝。
lines.en: I need no company, and don't refuse it.
My colours are brighter than the lights.
I hear traffic outside.
I rest the sign on my shoulder.
I count the guests coming in.

lines.zh: 我的气球头被风吹偏了。
lines.en: The draught pushes my balloon head askew.
Welcome. Have a look around.
You've been looking at me a long while.
Would you like a photo with me?

lines.zh: 我的牌子是给小孩看的。
lines.en: My sign is for the children.

lines.zh: 你站远一点，能看清整体。
lines.en: Stand back to see the whole of me.
By day I don't move; at night I do.

lines.zh: 我的手一直举着，你握一下？
lines.en: My hand is always up. Care to shake it?
Don't touch my balloon head.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道像爆米花。
lines.en: You smell like popcorn.
I tilt my head at you.
My streamer has been torn.
The sign fell to the floor.
I lean aside, gripping the cabinet.
My head is a little deflated.
The smile remains, but I don't move.
I retreat into the display spot.
I don't want to fight by day.
I right myself and keep standing.
My pose is spoiled.
I bend slowly to pick up the sign.
Is that candy in your hand?
I can't eat it, but I can hold it.
Hold it up where I can see.
My mouth won't open.
Set it on the counter.
The daytime me doesn't need these.
It's bright. Pretty.
I'm holding a sign; I can't take it.
Save it for the children.
I nod, very slowly.
The daytime me doesn't eat.
You stand before me holding it.
I can see it; I can't take it.
You lift it high; I look up.
My streamers are pinned under it.

lines.zh: 这不像客人会带的东西。
lines.en: Guests don't usually bring this.
You bumped my streamers.
I tilt and my balloon head sways.
I'm not steady. Don't push.
My sign nearly fell.
My shoes are painted on; you can't ruin them.
We bump and I smile.
I step aside, clearing the way.
I steady myself on the cabinet.
My head hit the door frame.
I reset my pose and keep standing.
I am only an exhibit.
Not during the day.
You should look for something that moves.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你看得出来。
lines.en: I stand still. You can see that.
My smile is printed on.
I have nothing to give.
At night there are others.
Don't knock the sign over.
I turn my streamers away.
This is not the place.

lines.zh: 我举起来对着灯照了照。
lines.en: I hold it up to the lamp.
This could be a prop.
I hang it on the display rack.
Is this a guest's?
I'll hold it for the owner.
I set it by the register.
I keep whatever falls.
If no one claims it, I keep it.

lines.zh: 我举着它，另一只手举牌。
lines.en: I hold it, the sign in the other hand.
You touched the display rack.
I turn, still smiling.
Even by day I can ask you to leave.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西不是你的。
lines.en: What you hold is not yours.
I raise a hand for you to stop.
The door is that way.
I dislike people rummaging.
Your shadow blocks my light.
I step forward and my streamers sway.

lines.zh: 我数到三，牌子就放下了。
lines.en: I count to three and lower the sign.
Wherever you move, I turn.

lines.zh: 我的牌子挡住了你的视线。
lines.en: My sign blocks your view.
You've backed between the cabinets.
I smile and say nothing.
There is only one exit here.
Your hand is in your pocket.
I approach, holding my sign up.
Touch it once more and see.
The lamp is behind me.
I swat you with my sign.

lines.zh: 我撞你，彩带缠住你的手。
lines.en: I ram you; streamers tangle your arm.
Not heavy, but loud.
I trip you with a foot.
I push you toward the door.
My balloon head bumps your face.
My smile hasn't changed at all.
Leave, and nothing more happens.
I raise the sign to block your hand.
The lights come on; I strike a pose.
I stand on the display spot.
Plenty of guests today.
My streamers are fresh.
The arcade music starts.
I greet guests at the door.
I raise my sign.

lines.zh: 空气里有爆米花的味道。
lines.en: The air smells of popcorn.
I set my head straight.
I wait for the first crowd.

lines.zh: 火一碰，我的彩带就卷了。
lines.en: Fire touches and my streamers curl.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，气球头先着地。
lines.en: I fell and my balloon head landed first.
Water soaked my streamers limp.
The blast shoves me into the arcade machine.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我的牌子。
lines.en: Something punched through my sign.
Spell-light pales my colours.
I don't eat; I only hold the sign.
At the thunder every light goes out.

lines.zh: 我从展示位上掉下去了。
lines.en: I have fallen off the display spot.
